decisions.basis: Profile body unchanged from full independent v1 PASS; copper, aqueous/solid salt, sugar, molten KBr and pure ethanol cases remain chemically coherent and independently varying.

Revised essential understanding and both cases now require only neutral P and Ca atomic/PSE reasoning, matching the canonical atom competence. P has Z=15, five outer electrons and three occupied shells; Ca has Z=20, two outer electrons and four occupied shells. The variation is meaningful, all German/English quantities match, and ion accounting is no longer a hidden mastery prerequisite.

Profile body unchanged from full independent v1 PASS; discrete molecule versus extended ionic lattice and CO2/CaF2 transfer remain chemically correct.

The revised ammonia/methane case now correctly says the N lone pair is not a fourth bonded atom. NH3 and CH4 both have four electron domains, while their molecular shapes are respectively trigonal pyramidal and tetrahedral. H2O/CO2 remain bent/linear with correct domain counts; German and English agree. The former misleading four-atom wording is absent.
